verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Brex has a one-click accounting sync feature, but it is documented only as syncing to Puzzle (brex-docs-17, 18, 40), with no mention of QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero, nor any documentation of finance-lead-controlled GL account, class, or department mapping for such syncs. Cost-center/department fields exist in the user API filters (brex-docs-19, 33) but these aren't tied to any accounting-sync mapping capability.
